authentication_order: Externally frozen completed six-pair native receipt SHA first; authenticate three model manifests, five artifacts each, pre-scoring boundary, pre-fit plan/provenance, all source rows, complete same-panel nine-block source evaluation, both-unseen/publication groups and fixed native feature report. Only then open cases.csv and historical WIsH.
scores: Exactly paired/host_only/phage_only, native T7/T3 by BL21/BW25113/MG1655 finite raw margins; no swap construct scores or favorable common-subset fallback. Saved scores consumed only, no fitting, inference, calibration or retuning.
primary_endpoint: Existing retrospective.evaluate_scores per-phage positive-negative concordance, ties0.5; mean informative phages only. T7 all3positive has no PN comparison; T3 alone informative. Old top1 primary is explicitly secondary here.
native_screen: Complete6native observations; paired concordance strictly>0.5 and strictly>historicalWIsH on exactly the same6. Host-only/phage-only attribution reported separately; no new admission gate.
coverage: 6of10 original cases; all4exchange cases remain abstained. A positive native screen cannot pass the complete ten-case gate.
source_evaluation: Retain complete nine-block source screen/macro/denominators. Negative source interaction-attribution screen cannot be bypassed by a native win. Final native diagnostic was independently prespecified, so execution does not depend on favorable source performance.
attribution: Record exact full frozen T7/T3 phage-vector equality and paired score-row equality without new admission gating. Equal phage vectors limit phage-input attribution. Whole-proteome association does not establish recognition-head representation.
permutation: After score authentication, exhaust all3T3single-positive placements. Report actual upper-tail fraction and best possible1/3; no independent replicate or significance claim.
legacy_helper_handling: Use existing retrospective evaluator numeric output. Move top1 to secondary_top1, rename legacy per-case mean_log_likelihood field to raw_score without numeric changes, omit hardcoded genome-composition/WIsH gate in favor of explicit new report decisions.
independence: No target-label, donor-identity or homolog-phenotype lookup for fitting/selection. This evaluator reads target labels only after saved-score authentication; method selection previously saw labels and remains exploratory. Actual separate anonymous native rerun is not established here.
report: Retain raw score matrices, all matched comparisons, tied/misordered cases, source negative results, coverage, stock uncertainty and limitations. No actual native report before authentic completed scores exist.
full_gate: HOLD while four experimental swap sequence identities remain unverified and independent validation/inference controls remain incomplete.
scientific_limits: No reliable generalization, protein/glycan binding, gp17 head engineering, assembly compatibility or functional infection claim; negative labels are condition-specific plaque nondetection.
prospective_attribution_interpretation: Paired concordance above a separately fitted host-only model is an ablation-screen difference, not proof that the paired model learned phage-conditional host ordering. Existing source screen keys and thresholds remain unchanged for compatibility; inspect within-model query variation and representation limits separately.
revision_reason: Before any biological model fit: replace privileged training-self projection with ordinary external-query projection after the preserved v2 candidate-control failure and prospectively fixed focal/complete-copy diagnostics. Version the missing-assignment control contract explicitly. No phenotype-dependent selection or threshold adjustment.
identity_semantics: Only the two SEARCH commands request --alignment-mode 3: aligned-residue sequence identity is computed for their --min-seq-id 0.4 criterion and downstream hit ranking, under unchanged seq-id/coverage defaults. Clustering retains its original --min-seq-id 0.4 score-based estimated-similarity parameter/default behavior; this is not an assertion of exact-identity clustering or exhaustive homology detection.

projection_symmetry.training_projection: Create an independent train_projection_db from the same normalized training.faa, then search it against train_db. No same-prefix training-self projection. Clustering still uses train_db only.
projection_symmetry.query_projection: Ordinary query_db against the same frozen train_db with identical SEARCH option vectors.
projection_symmetry.vocabulary_boundary: Fit from ordinary external training projections, including explicit missing-hit diagnostics; occurrence>1 training genome and occurrence-vector consolidation unchanged. Freeze after command6 before external query createdb command7.
projection_symmetry.control: Compare every copied protein under ordinary external training/query projection: count same assigned family, both unassigned and assignment discrepancies separately. Require zero assignment discrepancies, complete unique comparison coverage and exact feature-vector equality. Matched absence is not successful family identification. Report nonzero status separately; empty vocabulary is ready_for_fitting=false. This new v3 contract never relabels a v1/v2 failure.
projection_symmetry.legacy_artifact_names: self.tsv and best-self.json retain their filenames but now store ordinary external training projection, explicitly identified in the report.
projection_symmetry.unchanged: Source/target rosters, group splits, masks, labels, model settings, RFE rules, baselines, endpoints, decision thresholds and study interpretation.
